wiki-binance.standing: The Wikipedia article on Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Millions of retail traders hold funds on it, and much of the market's stablecoin and token liquidity clears through its order books.
wiki-binance.recent: Binance froze $2.54bn in customer funds after a theft the FBI pinned on North Korea's TraderTraitor, $6.3 billion in all; the exchange says malicious code and a fake job interview let the attackers in. It claims to have refilled 90% of the loss, yet users pulled a net $4.72 billion once withdrawals reopened, and Kim Yo-jong denied the hack.

stocks:688036.SS.standing: The Shenzhen maker of Tecno, Itel and Infinix phones, sold cheaply across Africa, South Asia and the Middle East. Thin margins on low-priced handsets leave it exposed to the cost of the chips inside them.
stocks:688036.SS.recent: Memory now exceeds 60% of the parts cost of a sub-$100 phone, the segment Transsion is built on, and IDC puts it at 40-50% of a low-end handset's cost across niche makers. That squeeze runs against the share's rise, and nothing reported in the fortnight about Transsion accounts for it.

poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if shipping through the Strait of Hormuz returns to normal by December 31. Roughly a fifth of the world's oil passes the strait, so the price is a bet on Gulf supply reopening.
poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.recent: Iran's offer of a 48-hour Hormuz reopening plan, made as Trump signalled progress in talks, gave way to a run of tanker fires. Iran's Revolutionary Guards say tankers hit mines on routes they had banned, and Iran's media say it targeted 11 tankers in 10 days. The US then called Iran's peace terms 'absurd'.

stocks:2222.SR.standing: Saudi Arabia's state oil company and the world's largest crude producer, with a small slice listed on the Riyadh exchange. The state owns nearly all of it, so its dividend is a pillar of the Saudi budget.
stocks:2222.SR.recent: Aramco reported third-quarter profit of $31.2 billion, up 9%, lifted by the higher oil prices of the Hormuz crisis, and began expanding an export route that bypasses the strait. The Houthi strikes that damaged Aramco Tower in Riyadh and set the East-West pipeline ablaze came after the chart's last reading.

stocks:GS.standing: The share price of Goldman Sachs, the New York investment bank listed on the NYSE. Its earnings ride on mergers, share issuance and trading volumes, so the stock tends to track how busy Wall Street's dealmaking is.

poly-will-ukraine-sign-an-eu-accession-t.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Ukraine signs its EU accession treaty by 2027. Signing comes only after every negotiating chapter closes and all 27 member states agree, so the price is a bet on the pace of talks in Brussels.
poly-will-ukraine-sign-an-eu-accession-t.recent: The fortnight's news on Ukraine and Europe was about ending the war, not about membership: Russia, Ukraine and the US opened talks in Abu Dhabi, and Germany threatened to block the EU budget unless it carried Ukraine aid. None of it touched the accession timetable or accounts for the price.

poly-pete-hegseth-out-as-secretary-of-de.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Pete Hegseth stops being the US Secretary of Defense before the end of the year. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on reports about his standing at the Pentagon.

stocks:CELH.standing: The share price of Celsius Holdings, a US maker of fitness-positioned energy drinks listed on the Nasdaq. Its growth rests on supermarket and convenience-store shelf space won through a distribution deal with PepsiCo.

stocks:EQIX.standing: The largest operator of colocation data centres, renting space, power and cross-connections to companies in dozens of countries. Structured as a real-estate investment trust, its shares track demand for cloud and AI infrastructure.
stocks:EQIX.recent: The one story about Equinix's own business in this period came from Cape Town, where a filing in an appeal confirmed it is the developer behind the data centres planned near the airport. A local planning dispute of that size does not account for the move in the share price.

stocks:7974.T.standing: Shares of Nintendo, the Kyoto maker of the Switch consoles and the Mario and Zelda games, listed in Tokyo. Its profits swing with each console cycle, and its own games keep selling for years after release.
stocks:7974.T.recent: First-half results on 2026-11-05 showed Switch 2 sales down 41% to 2.67 million units, with software sales offsetting the weaker hardware. The other company news of the month was a new Pokémon game, unveiled ahead of its November 7 release.

stocks:2914.T.standing: One of the world's largest cigarette makers, about a third owned by Japan's Ministry of Finance, selling Winston, Camel and Mevius outside the US through its international arm. Most of its profit is earned abroad.
stocks:2914.T.recent: Putin signed a decree putting Japan Tobacco International's Russian business, maker of 37% of Russia's tobacco market and its largest cigarette seller, under state control, and Tokyo demanded a reversal. The seizure came the day after the chart's last close, so it does not explain the climb before it.

stocks:TSM.standing: The world's largest contract chipmaker, based in Hsinchu, Taiwan, which builds the most advanced processors that other firms design, Apple's and Nvidia's among them. This is its share as listed in New York.

wiki-inflation.standing: The general rise in prices across an economy, usually measured by a consumer price index. Central banks set interest rates to keep it near a target, so its pace decides what borrowers and savers pay.
wiki-inflation.recent: Prices were climbing on several continents at once: Eurozone inflation hit 4%, the Bank of England raised rates, China's producer prices reached their highest since June 2022, and Thai inflation broke the central bank's ceiling. In the United States, core consumer prices rose 0.3% in October and the Fed's Logan called for two more rate hikes.

stocks:SHEL.standing: One of the world's largest oil and gas companies, headquartered in London, and the biggest trader of liquefied natural gas. Its profits track crude and gas prices, and its dividend is a fixture of British pension funds.

stocks:MPC.standing: The largest oil refiner in the United States by capacity, based in Findlay, Ohio, and the controlling owner of the MPLX pipeline partnership. Its shares trade on the crack spread, the gap between what crude costs and what petrol and diesel fetch.

stocks:VLO.standing: The largest independent oil refiner in the United States, with plants along the Gulf Coast, in Canada and the UK. It earns on the gap between crude and fuel prices, so its shares track refining margins more than oil itself.
stocks:VLO.recent: Valero said freight to Asia now costs $30-$35 a barrel, a premium that boosts US Gulf Coast refiners against those buying crude for Asia. That is a gain for its margins, and nothing else here about the company's own business accounts for the fall in its share.

stocks:DBK.DE.standing: Germany's largest bank, listed in Frankfurt, with an investment bank that earns a large share of its revenue. Its shares move with euro-area interest rates, legal costs and the health of the German industry it lends to.

stocks:002594.SZ.standing: The Shenzhen-listed shares of BYD, China's biggest seller of electric and plug-in hybrid cars. It makes its own batteries, so the same stock carries both its car margins and China's battery business.
stocks:002594.SZ.recent: BYD's Yangwang U9X reached 503.17 km/h on a closed highway in Abu Dhabi, a record for a production car. Separately, Chinese brands now supply 88.4% of Argentina's electric cars. Neither is a result, an order or a ruling that accounts for the share price.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will stake on the fighting stopping this year, not a forecast of it.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-by-decem.recent: Russia, Ukraine and the US held their first talks in 9 months in Abu Dhabi, but the agenda widened rather than narrowed: Washington pitched a security framework for all of Europe, which the EU had rebuffed days earlier, and Russian strikes kept hitting Odesa shipping and left 850,000 people without power around Dnipro.

stocks:IOC.NS.standing: India's largest oil refiner and fuel retailer, controlled by the central government. Its profits ride on the gap between what it pays for imported crude and the pump prices New Delhi keeps a hand on.
stocks:IOC.NS.recent: The only news about the petrol it sells came after the climb. Rahul Gandhi said 11 of 14 Karnataka samples breached the 20% ethanol limit, and oil marketing companies rejected the state's claims of 26-31% ethanol, citing testing irregularities. None of it accounts for the share's rise.

stocks:HINDPETRO.NS.standing: A state-controlled Indian refiner and fuel retailer, majority-owned by ONGC, with refineries in Mumbai and Visakhapatnam. Its profit lives in the gap between crude costs and pump prices the government keeps politically steady.

stocks:6818.HK.standing: A Beijing-based commercial bank controlled by the state-owned China Everbright Group, with shares listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai. Its loan book makes it a gauge of how China's mid-sized lenders are faring.
stocks:6818.HK.recent: The fortnight's one story about the bank itself was a bribery case: a former Everbright executive and their spouse took 4.29 million yuan in bribes disguised as salaries. It broke on the last day of the window, after the shares had already risen, and accounts for none of the move.

stocks:2357.TW.standing: The Taipei maker of Asus laptops, motherboards, graphics cards and ROG gaming hardware, listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange. It buys memory and chips it does not make, so its margins sit downstream of component prices.

wiki-china.standing: How many people open Wikipedia's article on China each day: a rough gauge of how often the world's second-largest economy and most populous one-party state pulls general readers toward the basics.
wiki-china.recent: The recent China stories ran from Washington pressing Beijing to implement its Busan commitments "fully and immediately" and the Pentagon delisting WuXi AppTec to comply with a court ruling, to US intelligence reportedly flagging Megaspeed's Alice Huang as Beijing's asset. None of it reaches back to the late-October peak.

poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Houthis and Saudi Arabia agree a ceasefire before the year ends. Its price is what traders will pay on the war between Yemen's Houthi movement and the kingdom ending, and so on Red Sea and Gulf oil risk.
poly-houthi-x-saudi-arabia-effective-cea.recent: The war widened instead of winding down. Saudi Arabia signed a defence deal with Damascus and Syrian military trainers arrived. Houthis claimed six strikes inside the kingdom, debris blew out windows across Aramco Tower in Riyadh, and an unclaimed attack set the East-West pipeline ablaze, while Saudi strikes near Sanaa killed 27 villagers.

stocks:6301.T.standing: Japan's largest maker of construction and mining machinery, and the world's second after Caterpillar. Its excavators and haul trucks sell on mining investment and building activity, so its orders read the global capital-spending cycle.

stocks:7203.T.standing: Japan's largest company and the world's biggest carmaker by vehicles sold, listed in Tokyo. Most of its sales are abroad, so its profits, and its share price, swing with the yen and with tariffs on cars entering the United States.

wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.standing: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps is Iran's parallel military, founded after the 1979 revolution and answerable to the Supreme Leader. It runs the missile force, a navy in the Gulf and a large business empire.
wiki-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps.recent: The Guards say tankers taking routes through Hormuz they have not authorised are hitting mines; four were burning at once, and a seafarer died aboard the Velos Sapphire. In France, prosecutors say the Revolutionary Guards hacked freezers in 700 French supermarkets, and Paris summoned Iran's envoy.

stocks:GEV.standing: The power-equipment maker spun off from General Electric in 2024, building gas and wind turbines and grid gear. Its gas-turbine order book is one of the clearest reads on how fast utilities are adding generation.

stocks:9502.T.standing: The utility that supplies electricity to Nagoya and central Japan's manufacturing belt, home to Toyota. It owns the Hamaoka nuclear plant in Shizuoka and half of JERA, Japan's largest power generator and fuel buyer.

stocks:9983.T.standing: The Tokyo-listed parent of Uniqlo, Asia's largest clothing retailer, which now earns more than half its sales abroad. It carries a heavy weight in the price-weighted Nikkei 225, so its share moves Japan's benchmark more than almost any other.
stocks:9983.T.recent: Uniqlo reversed a sock price increase within days, a sign of how quickly Japanese shoppers push back on higher prices. That retreat came after the last close shown, and nothing reported in the fortnight accounts for the share's rise.

wiki-united-states.standing: Daily reads of English Wikipedia's article on the United States, one of its most-visited country pages. It rises when American power or politics becomes the world's story, not only America's.
wiki-united-states.recent: Trump called the midterms dishonest after Republicans lost both chambers, while Vance said the Iran war was the reason they lost. Days later Trump said strikes on Iran were highly unlikely as talks led by Rubio stalled.

poly-pete-hegseth-out-as-secretary-of-de.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Pete Hegseth leaves the post of US Secretary of Defense by the stated deadline. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on reports about his standing with the White House.

stocks:TFG.JO.standing: A Cape Town-based clothing, jewellery and homeware retailer listed in Johannesburg, behind chains such as Foschini, Markham and @home, with businesses in Britain and Australia. Its sales track South African household budgets.

poly-next-us-iran-senior-diplomatic-meet.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if senior US and Iranian officials meet in person before its deadline. Its price is what traders will stake on direct talks between two governments that have rarely sat at one table.
poly-next-us-iran-senior-diplomatic-meet.recent: Mohsen Rezaei, Iran's top security official, says there are no negotiations with Washington and that the US must first meet seven conditions from the June interim agreement, cutting against the Qatari mediation track. Abbas Araghchi added a promise of hell if US strikes resume.

stocks:CAT.standing: The world's largest maker of construction and mining machinery, and a major builder of engines, turbines and generators. Its order book tracks spending on mines, roads, oil and gas, and on-site power for data centres.

stocks:BX.standing: The New York firm that is the world's largest alternative asset manager, running private equity, property, credit and hedge-fund money for pensions and endowments. Its share price tracks deal-making and the value of private assets.

stocks:0100.HK.standing: A Shanghai-based artificial intelligence lab that builds large language, video and voice models, listed in Hong Kong. Its shares are a direct price on one of China's challengers to the American AI labs.
stocks:0100.HK.recent: The one story about MiniMax in this window was its listing of 16 openings in San Francisco, part of a push by Chinese AI labs to hire Americans; nothing in it accounts for the fall in its shares.

stocks:SGRO.L.standing: A UK real estate investment trust and one of Europe's largest landlords of warehouses and industrial estates, Slough's among them. It also builds data centres, so its rents follow logistics demand and grid power.

stocks:PLD.standing: The world's largest owner of logistics warehouses, a US real estate investment trust leasing distribution space near ports and cities. Its rents and occupancy track how much goods trade and online retail need storing.

stocks:RWE.DE.standing: Shares in RWE, Germany's largest power producer, listed in Frankfurt. It is pivoting from lignite and gas plants to wind and solar, so the stock trades on European power prices, carbon costs and the pace of that build-out.

stocks:HEI.DE.standing: One of the world's largest makers of cement and aggregates, based in Heidelberg, Germany. Cement is carbon-heavy, so its shares answer to construction demand and to the price of EU emissions permits.

stocks:KOG.OL.standing: Norway's largest defence contractor, half-owned by the Norwegian state, maker of the NASAMS air-defence system and naval strike missiles. Its share moves on European defence budgets and on orders from NATO governments.

stocks:2359.HK.standing: A Chinese contract research and manufacturing company, listed in Shanghai and Hong Kong, that makes drug ingredients and runs lab work for Western pharmaceutical firms. Its share price tracks how far Washington lets that dependence run.
stocks:2359.HK.recent: The Pentagon dropped WuXi AppTec from its 'Chinese military companies' list to comply with a court ruling. That entry would have opened the way to naming it a biotech 'company of concern' under the BIOSECURE push, the step that decides whether US drugmakers can keep it as a supplier.

wiki-anthropic.standing: Anthropic is the San Francisco artificial-intelligence company that builds the Claude models. Former OpenAI researchers founded it, and it sells its models to businesses and developers in competition with OpenAI and Google.
wiki-anthropic.recent: Anthropic filed to go public, and its prospectus showed an $80.7 billion loss in six months. Cat Wu, who led Claude Code, left for OpenAI 10 days later. The roadshow opened with Google and Nvidia each buying $10 billion of the company, a day after it released Fable and Mythos 5.2, the same model split into two tiers by safety policy.

poly-another-fed-rate-hike-in-2026.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the US Federal Reserve raises its policy rate again before 2026 ends. That rate sets borrowing costs for mortgages, companies and governments, and every dollar-linked market moves with it.
poly-another-fed-rate-hike-in-2026.recent: October's consumer prices came in hot, core up 0.3% even as petrol fell to a four-month low. Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan then called for at least two more quarter-point hikes, Waller and other Fed speakers turned hawkish, and two-year Treasury yields jumped 18 basis points as the risk of a half-point December hike was priced in.

stocks:SBK.JO.standing: Africa's largest lender by assets, based in Johannesburg and operating across some 20 African countries. China's ICBC owns about a fifth of it, making it a main conduit for Chinese trade and lending on the continent.
stocks:SBK.JO.recent: The one story about the bank's own business in this period asked whether Standard Bank's climate claims survive its role financing the East African Crude Oil Pipeline. Nothing in it accounts for the share's rise.

poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine reach a peace deal by the end of 2027. Its price is what traders will stake on that outcome, and it moves on talks, strikes and signals from Washington, Moscow and Kyiv.
poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.recent: The bets climbed as the Abu Dhabi talks approached. Trump met Putin envoy Kirill Dmitriev at the White House, and Russia sent 5 senior officials to the table. When the first peace talks in 9 months opened on 10 November, a US official said Ukraine could get NATO-like guarantees.

stocks:S68.SI.standing: The company that runs Singapore's stock and derivatives exchanges and their clearing houses. Much of its income comes from futures on Asian assets, from Chinese equities to iron ore, so trading volume drives its earnings.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.standing: A Polymarket contract on Anthropic, the AI lab behind the Claude models: it pays out if the company's market value at the close of its first day of public trading is below $1.25 trillion.

stocks:BP.standing: American shares of BP, the London-based oil and gas major that produces crude and gas, refines it and sells fuel worldwide. Its earnings rise and fall with oil prices and refining margins.
stocks:BP.recent: BP reported a surge in profit on a refining windfall, a lift for O'Neill's turnaround, and analysts expect eight oil majors to make over $350bn in operating cash between them. Neither the results nor the cash explains the slide in the shares that followed.

stocks:XOM.standing: America's largest oil company, pumping crude and gas from the Permian Basin to Guyana's offshore fields and refining fuel and chemicals worldwide. Its shares track oil and gas prices more closely than the wider market.

poly-will-bola-tinubu-win-the-2027-niger.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Bola Tinubu wins Nigeria's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay on a second term for the president of Africa's most populous country.

poly-will-david-lisnard-win-the-2027-fre.standing: What traders will pay for a contract that pays out if David Lisnard, the centre-right mayor of Cannes, wins France's 2027 presidential election. It prices his chances in a crowded field on the right.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: What traders pay for a contract that settles yes if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei, a capital the opposition Kuomintang has usually held.

poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve leaves its policy rate unchanged at its January 2027 meeting. Its price is what traders will pay for a pause, and it moves on inflation data and on what Fed officials say in public.
poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.recent: October's consumer prices ran hot, core up 0.3%, and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan called for at least two more quarter-point hikes, possibly quickly. Waller and other Fed speakers turned hawkish, and two-year Treasury yields jumped 18 basis points as traders priced a half-point hike in December, making a January pause harder to bet on.

stocks:7202.T.standing: The Japanese maker of commercial trucks, pickups and diesel engines, listed in Tokyo. Thailand is its pickup base, so its shares move with the yen and with freight and farm demand across Southeast Asia.

poly-will-john-mcentee-win-the-2028-repu.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if John McEntee, who ran the White House personnel office under Donald Trump, wins the Republican nomination for the 2028 presidential election. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays if Anthropic, the private AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $2 trillion or more by year's end. With no listed shares, it is a bet on the terms of its next funding round or share sale.

stocks:MSFT.standing: Shares in the maker of Windows, Office and the Azure cloud, one of the world's most valuable companies. Its OpenAI stake and its data-centre spending make it a bellwether for whether the AI build-out pays.
stocks:MSFT.recent: Microsoft passed Nvidia in market value for the first time since June 2025 because Nvidia fell: its board is investigating Jensen Huang over his ties to a suspected Chinese intelligence target. Kaspersky's BlackX bootkit on fully patched Windows machines and protesters storming a planned Microsoft site were Microsoft's own news, and neither explains the share.

stocks:TTE.standing: France's largest oil and gas company, producing crude and LNG from Africa to the Middle East and the North Sea, and building a power business. This line is its New York listing, priced in dollars.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Israel-Iran ceasefire is still holding on 31 December. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on every strike, threat and report of talks.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: The bets firmed after Trump said strikes on Iran were highly unlikely and that Gulf neighbours had asked him to hold fire, days after Vance blamed the Iran war for the midterm defeat. No deal sits behind it: Rezaei denies any talks with Washington and says the US must first meet seven conditions.

wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.standing: Daily readers of the Wikipedia article on Benjamin Netanyahu, Likud's leader and Israel's longest-serving prime minister. He has shaped Israeli politics, and its wars and its courts, for three decades.
wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.recent: Israel's election left neither bloc at 61 seats without the Arab parties, and Shin Bet rejected Netanyahu's claim that Arab voters had committed fraud. Herzog then gave Eisenkot the mandate after 67 of 120 Knesset members backed him over Netanyahu's 46, leaving Netanyahu a caretaker who still commands the security services.

wiki-nvidia.standing: Nvidia, the Santa Clara chip designer whose graphics processors run most of the world's AI training, and one of the most valuable companies on earth. Its fortunes carry the chip sector and the data-centre build-out with them.
wiki-nvidia.recent: Nvidia's board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang over an affair with Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive US intelligence reportedly flagged as Beijing's asset. Shares fell 6.27%, Microsoft briefly passed Nvidia in market value, and the senior Republican on the Senate Banking Committee called on Huang to resign.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-on-november-19-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab that makes Claude, lists its shares publicly on November 19, 2026. A listing would put a public market price on one of the leading AI developers for the first time.

stocks:SCC.BK.standing: Thailand's largest industrial group, listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand and part-owned by the Crown Property Bureau. It makes cement, building materials, petrochemicals and packaging across Southeast Asia.
stocks:SCC.BK.recent: The one development on the company's own business came after the latest close: SCG said its core plastics plant in Vietnam, knocked out by the Hormuz disruption, stays shut until mid-2027. Nothing in the input accounts for the slide before that.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Crude oil and the fuels refined from it: petrol, diesel, jet fuel and the feedstock for plastics. It supplies about a third of the world's energy, and its price runs through transport, food and inflation almost everywhere.
wiki-petroleum.recent: October ended with Brent at $117.56, up about 15% on the month, as a US threat over Hormuz carried the Iran war into the oil price. November reversed it: JP Morgan put October at a 1.4 million barrel-a-day surplus, and Brent fell below $90 for the first time since August, even as Houthi missiles damaged Aramco Tower in Riyadh.

poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2028. Impeachment takes only a simple House majority, so the price lives on who controls the chamber.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-by-november-19-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI company behind the Claude models, lists its shares publicly by November 19, 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-trump-speak-to-volodymyr-zelen.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Donald Trump and Volodymyr Zelenskyy speak before its deadline. Direct contact between the two has marked each shift in Washington's backing for Ukraine against Russia.

poly-will-spacex-have-the-highest-ipo-ma.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether SpaceX's stock market debut carries the highest valuation of any company that lists in 2026. It is a bet both that Elon Musk's rocket and Starlink maker goes public at all and that no other listing outsizes it.

wiki-data-center.standing: A building full of servers, storage and network equipment, with the power and cooling to run them around the clock. They host cloud computing and AI training, which turns their electricity and water use into local politics.
wiki-data-center.recent: Voters rejected data centers in 38 of 40-plus contests at the US midterms, after household power bills in Ohio rose over 20% in two years. The next day Nvidia fell 6%, AMD 12% and Micron 11%, and over 100 groups planned Europe-wide protests from Friday.

poly-ai-industry-downturn-by-december-31.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if an AI bubble is judged to have burst before the end of 2026, a bet on whether the money poured into AI chips, data centres and lab valuations unwinds within the year.

poly-pete-hegseth-impeached-by-december-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2027. Impeachment takes a simple House majority, so the price leans on which party holds the chamber.

poly-will-benjamin-netanyahu-be-the-next.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Benjamin Netanyahu leaves office as Israel's prime minister before 2027. Its price is what traders will pay to bet on that, and it moves on coalition votes, courts and elections.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $1.75 trillion or more by Dec 31. It is a bet on whether a new funding round or share sale sets that mark before the year ends.
poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.recent: The fortnight's news touching this contract was about prediction markets themselves, not Anthropic: the CFTC sued Utah to protect Kalshi from the state's gambling ban, and Polymarket pledged $3.9 million to victims of a site compromise. None of it accounts for the price.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the Florida Republican and former senator, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will stake on that outcome, in cents on the dollar.
poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-us-pr.recent: The weeks around the midterm blowout carried JD Vance clashing with Trump and blaming the Iran war for the crushing defeat, an open split at the top of the party's 2028 field. None of it names Marco Rubio, and none of it accounts for what traders pay on him.

stocks:IBM.standing: International Business Machines, the century-old American computing company, now earns most of its money from hybrid-cloud software, Red Hat and mainframes sold to banks and governments, with a consulting arm alongside.
stocks:IBM.recent: The one development in its own business is a plan to link two 520-qubit chips into a 1,040-qubit system that users can reach in 2027, a step on its roadmap to error-corrected quantum computers before 2030. That was announced after the latest close, so it does not explain the share's climb.

poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and Oman, the two states on either shore of the Strait of Hormuz, reach an agreement on the strait by November 30. The price is what traders pay for a yes.
poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.recent: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf says Tehran and Muscat agreed a shipping corridor and traffic separation scheme for the strait, a claim carried by TASS that Oman has not confirmed. The same day the Revolutionary Guards said three tankers hit mines, and Rezaei tied reopening Hormuz to Washington's answer on Iran's seven conditions.
